Equation 12:
P=\left(\frac{X_{\mathrm{C}}}{X_{c d}}\right)\times P_{\mathrm{m}}\times\frac{I_{\mathrm{a v g}}}{I_{\mathrm{s a t}}}\times\exp\left(1-\frac{I_{\mathrm{a v g}}}{I_{\mathrm{s a t}}}\right)

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  P  ->  P   (Photosynthesis rate normalized to functional biomass)
  I_{avg}  ->  Iavg   (Instantaneous light intensity averaged over the optical path of the reactor)
  I_{sat}  ->  Isat   (Saturated light intensity in the photosynthesis equation)
  X_{C}  ->  XC   (Total fixed organic carbon concentration)
  X_{cd}  ->  Xcd   (Concentration of functional biomass (algal biomass excluding carbohydrates and neutral lipids) as C)
  P_{m}  ->  Pm   (Maximum-rate coefficient in the photosynthesis equation)
